name: Shunjuu Utako
source:
Affiliation: Hazuki Private School 3rd year, Group A (Formerly: Satsuki Academy) / Former student council president
Favorite food: Konnyaku Jelly
Gift: Cat Box (the ability to erase your existence or simply make yourself disappear)

Utako's a silent bookworm, and she's always holding a book and reading throughout the game. Back in their Satsuki school days, Utako was the former student council president.

[From [url=http://visualnovelspam.blogspot.fi/2013/08/hyperhighspeedgenius-thoughts.html]Visual Novel Spam[/url]]
